## Why this change is needed

The registered-interface Core increment adds fixed per-row sampling, same-Good selected viable deployment risk, and finite-carrier observation proofs. Its source-derived DAG and native reuse evidence need to be integrated into six existing consumers, whose default L1 policy correctly prevents edits without authorization from canonical main.

## Change

Replace the completed and retired support-viability exception with `TC-REGISTERED-INTERFACES-EVIDENCE-2026-10-21`, restricted to the exact branch `compression/theory-completion-registered-interfaces`. The same six exact consumer paths remain authorized. Only the exception ID, exact branch pattern and explanation change.

Existing Lean modules, frozen mathematical surfaces, counted ledgers and workflows are unchanged. New Core modules and root imports will be published in a separate PR after this authorization is canonical.

## Validation

Candidate: `6777a727c1df0618ef7d52800e3528c37e7c48d4`; base: `65db00a12d20be41cd6c8befacb9ba2e74a2a8a9`.

All five checks were executed sequentially in the authenticated Mac environment, using the actual base scripts: compression validation with live FINAL references, compression regressions, research authorization with live branch state, research regressions, and finalization-receipt regressions. All passed and the candidate remained clean.

Independent exact-head review confirmed that every other byte and JSON value is unchanged, including all six paths, the TC scope and the temporary flag. Earlier cloud attempts and their failure reasons are retained separately; they are not substituted for the authenticated checks.

Lean compilation is not a claim of this governance-only PR. This change does not create or replace a counted FINAL push-event receipt.
